g.text: E = “cannot tell from the passage” · percentage of all 65 active MCQs

g.text: — = not evaluated. Invalid answers remain in the denominator and are not counted as E.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526578

g.text: Rates describe E selection, not whether E was appropriate. Each dose refers to omission across the full passage.
